en.title: Department of Agriculture: 20 references to U.S. Code sections repealed, omitted or not in the Code (7 CFR, chapter II, parts 220 to 283)
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Department of Agriculture in 7 CFR, chapter II, parts 220 to 283, 20 references in 9 sections cite a U.S. Code section that release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code does not carry in force: 8 cite a number the Code does not have; 7 cite a section omitted from the Code; 5 cite a repealed section. The release names no successor for these sections.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references does not reach the text the rule relies on. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides whether to remove or replace each reference. The U.S. Code names no successor for these sections.
